text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got their time back. Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, less typing in parking lots between visits.

2. CRM data got better. Next steps and decision-makers were captured consistently, not remembered on Friday afternoon.

3. Trust took work. Some customers hesitated until reps explained how recordings were stored and used. Asking for consent up front mattered every time.

4. Summaries aren't strategy. Managers still had to coach on what the notes revealed.

The biggest lesson: the tool helped most when we changed the habits around it.

What would you want from an AI note-taker on your team?
